title: Miscellaneous Essays
author: Thomas De Quincey

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Penson De Quincey was an English writer, essayist, and literary critic, best known for his Confessions of an English Opium-Eater (1821). Many scholars suggest that in publishing this work De Quincey inaugurated the tradition of addiction literature in the Western world.

description: "Miscellaneous Essays" by Thomas De Quincey is a collection of reflective essays written during the early 19th century. This work showcases De Quincey’s unique blend of literary analysis and philosophical inquiry, addressing a variety of topics, including literature, art, morality, and the nature of murder itself.
